context: This criteria evaluates the ability to configure request timeouts including deadline timeout (total time) and response timeout (time to first byte), and handle timeout errors.

checklist.name: Timeout configuration
checklist.description: Correctly configures request timeout using the timeout method with either simple milliseconds or an object with response and deadline properties

checklist.name: Timeout error handling
checklist.description: Properly catches and handles timeout errors, distinguishing them from other types of errors

checklist.name: Granular control
checklist.description: Demonstrates understanding of both response and deadline timeout configurations
